about: EMPTY ON PURPOSE (19 Oct 2026). An empty list turns the thin-page rule off, so nothing is noindexed. The 6,855-path list made on 11 Oct was short: whereanime was being shown 16,240 times a day, so far more pages were earning impressions than the list held, and the noindex that shipped on 11-12 Oct cut Google impressions by about 99% within a day. The old list is kept beside this file as index-keep.truncated-2026-10-11.json. Do not fill this file again until a per-page Search Console pull with full pagination proves the page class earns nothing.
